{"id":1836229327,"question_id":202,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"8 months","timestamp":1763750308,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1836229327/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Happy Number","memory":"8.3 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int sumSq(int n) \n    {\n        int sum = 0;\n        while(n) \n        {\n            int d = n % 10;\n            sum += d * d;\n            n /= 10;\n        }\n        return sum;\n    }\n\n    bool isHappy(int n) {\n        unordered_set<int> seen;\n\n        while(!seen.count(n)) \n        {\n            seen.insert(n);\n            n = sumSq(n);\n            if(n == 1) return true;\n        }\n        return false; \n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"happy-number","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1155}
